description: Named stress scenarios for iap.portfolio.factor_risk.run_stress (v1.18 REL-17). Each scenario is a set of factor moves in return units: 'market' is the reference-ETF return (it reaches each name through its beta); 'sector:<name>' moves are residual sector returns ON TOP of the market move. Market magnitudes are rounded one-day S&P 500 closes on the named dates from public index history; sector and size moves are hypothetical, stated as such, and not calibrated to any dataset.

scenarios.name: tech_selloff
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: market -3 % with Information Technology a further -6 % and Communication Services -4 %.

scenarios.name: rotation_value
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: no market move; Information Technology -4 %, Financials +4 %, Energy +5 %.

scenarios.name: liquidity_crunch
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: market -4 % and the least-liquid names (bucket q1, the baseline) lag: the middle bucket q2 +2 % and the most-liquid bucket q3 +4 % relative to q1.
